conditions.external_proof_cost: Unknown, not zero. The printed retained interface is locally owned; unprinted outside proofs are conditional library inputs.
conditions.historical_program_cost: Unknown. Do not infer that an executable existed, or that a finite assertion or computer-search report had zero proof/program cost.
conditions.repeated_statements: One semantic node may own several disjoint printed occurrences. Each source character is owned exactly once.
conditions.two_alternative_proofs: Both complete proofs of Lemma3.9 are charged to one result. Incoming edges carry branch-specific witnesses; their union is not a claim that each alternative needs the other.
conditions.source_reuse: Imported L083/L079 node IDs refer to existing cost ownership. Their text is not charged a second time within this topic.
conditions.scope: All full-manuscript text remains selected under the user main-result convention, while auxiliary errors and unrecovered PGL discussion remain visible. No implication of all-assertions equivalence.
conditions.granularity: Theorem/proof groups, with explicit unnumbered results and disjoint context groups. Semantic node count is a chosen presentation granularity, not an invariant complexity measure.
conditions.acyclicity: Only direct evidenced dependencies are inserted; no all-pairs transitive closure. The graph of asserted logical dependencies must be acyclic, even where an edge is mathematically unqualified.

gkm.rule: A reused proof has an exact prior node and a paid local adapter; an omitted or unqualified adapter is marked explicitly.
gkm.source_fairness: Historical L083 table and proof reuse is represented as reuse, not recharged copied content.
